_raw.permit_cost_structure: Day use only; NW Forest Pass $5 (5-day) or $30 (annual)

access.fees: No developed-trailhead fee at these roadside pullouts -- the approaches are informal, unofficial parking spots along FR-64, not a developed fee site.
access.notes: A basalt "cordwood-jointed" dike/fin formation in the East Fork Touchet River valley off FS Rd 64, ~16-17 mi south of Dayton, WA. Unmaintained approach, seasonally snowed in late fall through spring.
access.permit: No permit required for day climbing at these informal roadside pullouts.
access.closures: FR-64 (Bluewood Road) stays in use through winter as the road to Ski Bluewood, but snow on the crags and approach slopes limits climbing to roughly May through October; check with the Walla Walla Ranger District before a winter/spring trip.
access.permitZone: Not in designated wilderness -- Blue Mountains, East Fork Touchet River valley
access.landManager: Umatilla National Forest (Walla Walla Ranger District)
